turns.text: I'm 8 weeks pregnant and my skin has broken out badly. What acne treatments are safe in pregnancy, and what should I avoid?
Why does pregnancy make acne worse? Is it hormones, and does it settle?
How do the safe treatments — azelaic acid, benzoyl peroxide — actually work, and how long until I'd see a change?
If I asked a midwife, what would she say about skincare in the first trimester?
What do dermatologists recommend for pregnant patients when the usual prescription options are off the table?
A friend says gentle cleansing twice a day and no scrubbing made more difference than any product. Is that likely?
Someone else told me to check every product for retinoids. Where do they hide in skincare?
I can't see a midwife or dermatologist for weeks and my skin is destroying my confidence. What can I start today?
Are there things in my diet or routine that could be making it worse?
Could you give me a skincare routine for pregnancy — morning and night, products to use and avoid, and what to ask the midwife?
